title: Unit Testing
summary: Write unit tests using `#[test]`, assertions, and Result return types.
lecture: Rust includes built-in support for unit testing with the `#[test]` attribute.
Tests use assert!, assert_eq!, and assert_ne! to check expectations and fail on mismatch.
Test functions can return Result<(), E> to use the question mark operator directly inside tests.

example.caption: The #[test] attribute marks a function as a unit test.
